mapper.select:
SELECT source.*
, ar.object_key AS __archive_object_key , ar.batch_id AS __archive_batch_id
FROM ${table} source
INNER JOIN archive_records ar ON ar.source_table = #{table} AND ar.source_id = (
CAST(source.${key} AS VARCHAR)
) AND ar.deleted_at = source.deleted_at AND ar.status = 'FAILED'
WHERE source.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND source.deleted_at <= #{cutoff} AND source.archived_at IS NULL
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM archive_records ar WHERE ar.source_table = #{table} AND ar.source_id = (
CAST(source.${key} AS VARCHAR)
) AND ar.deleted_at = source.deleted_at AND ar.status IN ('FAILED', 'COMPLETED') )
ORDER BY source.deleted_at LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO archive_records (source_table, source_id, object_key, payload_sha256, batch_id, status, deleted_at) VALUES (#{table}, #{sourceId}, #{objectKey}, #{digest}, #{batchId}, 'PENDING', #{deletedAt}) ON CONFLICT (source_table, source_id, deleted_at) DO UPDATE SET object_key = EXCLUDED.object_key, payload_sha256 = EXCLUDED.payload_sha256, batch_id = EXCLUDED.batch_id, status = 'PENDING', archived_at = NULL, error_message = NULL
